title: env-handle contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-30). The SHAPE of the provisioned-environment handle the `env` slot's producer (default faffter-noon-env-compose) emits — a description of a running, health-checked stand-in for the system under build that the holdout evaluator (FAFF-34) points at and tears down. Shape is normative here; the provisioning MECHANISM (compose now, cloud later) lives in the producer, not the contract. Fail-loud on a non-object input (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). status is a plain string here: its {ready,provisioning,failed,terminated} enum is enforced in the compute fn via violations (the architecture-proposal recommendation precedent), so an echoed bad value (exit 1) never trips schemaCheck into a spurious fail-loud (exit 2). The compute fn also enforces the cross-field rule that exit 0 requires status=ready AND a non-empty endpoint AND non-empty health_checks — a non-ready env is never gate-passing. endpoint is required only when ready, so it is enforced in compute, not as a schema required field.
